# `permission_denied`

A permission check refused a caller the surface knows.

| Status | Title | `type` |
|---|---|---|
| `403` | Permission denied | `https://substrat.net/errors/permission-denied` |

`403` is also the status of [`forbidden`](/errors/forbidden), so switch on `code`, not on the status.

## What it means

The caller is known, and `ctx.check` said no: no role or grant they hold carries the key the operation checks. `permission` names that key. When the check was made on one record rather than on the whole scope, `entity` names the record. A refusal that more permissions would not change is `forbidden`, the other `403`.

## When it is returned

- The permission check an operation makes before anything else refused.
- A per-entity check refused; `entity` is set.

## What it carries

- `permission`: The permission key the check refused.
- `entity`: The record the refusal is about, as an entity reference (`{ entityType, entityId }`).

See [the body](/errors/#the-body) for the members any problem may carry.

## What to do

Do not retry. The same request is refused until the caller's access changes. Ask whoever administers the scope for a role that carries `permission`, or stop offering the action to this user.

## In `/openapi.json`

Documented on every operation's failure responses.
